Solutions

Our platform services a wide range of use cases, industries and internal job roles. Our API surface and console functionality provides the freedom to craft a bespoke security solution that teams can use to carry out a wide range of internal functions, from SOC operations to threat hunting, digital risk protection and feed management.

										

					
									
				

Use cases

Our modular solution is applicable to a broad spectrum of public and private sector use cases, across a wide range of sectors. Our enriched data sources are adaptable to a variety of sec ops workflows, including SOC teams, threat hunters, data analysts, reverse engineers and security researchers.

See Use Cases

										

					
									
				

Industries

From government agencies to international law enforcement organizations, financial services organizations, security vendors, retail and investment banks, and large commercial operators. Silent Push first-party data is applicable within a huge range of global industries and sub-sectors.

See Industries
